Project Manager - Turbojet Engineering

Madrid, Comunidad de Madrid, España · Full time · 78 applicants
HybridEasy Apply
Easy Apply

Shape the Future of Propulsion

About the Role

Drive the development of advanced turbojet engines from early concept through testing, qualification and production. Bring structure, pace and accountability to complex propulsion programs, keeping engineering, manufacturing, suppliers and stakeholders aligned.

Own planning and execution across multiple development programs, including schedules, budgets, resources, risks, milestones and deliverables. Understand the engineering context, anticipate challenges, remove roadblocks and keep programs moving.

Destinus is a European aerospace and defence company developing UAVs and autonomous flight systems for mission-critical applications.

What You'll Do

  • Lead turbojet projects from concept through design, manufacture, test, qualification and production.
  • Maintain schedules, budgets, resource plans, milestones, risks and delivery plans.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary teams, dependencies and deliverables.
  • Identify bottlenecks early and drive actions to resolution.
  • Organize project and technical/customer reviews; document decisions and actions.
  • Manage customer communication, reporting, contractual deliverables and milestones.
  • Coordinate suppliers and partners for hardware, services and documentation.
  • Monitor costs, resources, KPIs and program performance.
  • Support transition into qualification, production and customer delivery.

What You'll Need

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Aerospace, Mechanical or a related engineering discipline.
  • 5+ years managing complex engineering development projects, preferably aerospace, propulsion or turbomachinery.
  • Technical understanding of gas turbines, propulsion systems or complex mechanical products is desirable.
  • Proven schedule, budget, resource, risk and customer-deliverable management.
  • Microsoft Project, Jira or equivalent tools.
  • Fluent English; other European languages are an advantage.

Who You Are

  • Proactive, structured and accountable without slowing teams down.
  • A clear communicator with engineers, suppliers, customers and executives.
  • Able to spot risks and dependencies and convert them into actions.
  • Comfortable with shifting priorities and ambitious aerospace hardware programs.
